note: Written by the evening check (Claude). Own words, verified facts only, each with its source. Display only: no entry or exit rule reads this file.

market.summary: The gap-up faded: the Nifty closed 0.34% lower at 22,811 after touching 23,121, and the broad market sold off hard (Smallcap 100 -2.5% to a four-month low, Midcap 100 -1.6%; about 2,988 NSE stocks fell vs 608 that rose). Oil near $111 on Middle East supply worries and a US 10-year yield above 5% drove it; IT was the only sector up (+2.9%, eight-month high). For these holdings: IT strength helps HCLTECH, while the small/mid-cap selling is what pushed SEJALLTD and GROWW onto their stops.

points.text: Nifty 50 closed at 22,811.35 (-77.6 pts, -0.34%) after a 23,016 open and 23,120.90 high; Sensex 73,709.69 (-0.19%); Bank Nifty below 55,000 (-0.92%).

Nifty Smallcap 100 fell about 2.5% to a four-month low, breaking a head-and-shoulders neckline; next support cited at 18,184-18,368 (200-day average / June gap). India VIX at a four-month high; 362 stocks at 52-week lows vs 44 at highs.
Brent near $110.8 and WTI near $99.9 in the afternoon on supply-disruption fears (Saudi facilities, shipping security).
Nifty IT +2.88% with all ten stocks up, on Q2 beats, deal wins and AI partnerships; Infosys reports on Fri 23 Oct.
NSE provisional flows 21 Oct: FIIs bought about Rs 1,022 Cr, DIIs bought about Rs 1,614 Cr; FIIs are still net sellers of about Rs 6,103 Cr over 5 sessions.

market.watch: Whether small caps find support near the 200-day average, Brent above $110, Infosys results on 23 Oct, and the Jio IPO (closes 23 Oct) drawing money from the market.

HCLTECH.summary: HCLTECH rose 3.2% to 1,424.20, the second-best Nifty stock, as the whole IT sector rallied against a falling market. The only company filing today is a product launch (an NVIDIA-based software-testing service for carmakers, no value or client disclosed), so the move is sector-driven. The trade is at +0.87R, about 1% under +1R (1,437.78); a close there moves the stop to cost.

points.text: Closed 1,424.20, +3.21% on the day, behind only Infosys (+3.30%) among Nifty gainers.
21 Oct filing: launch of 'V&V for Auto', an NVIDIA-powered virtual testing service for vehicle software; no deal value or customer named.
Anand Rathi moved to Buy (target Rs 1,435) after Q2; HCLTech raised the bottom of its FY27 growth guidance to 2.5-4.0% in constant currency.
Interim dividend Rs 12 per share (record date 16 Oct) is paid on 26 Oct; it does not affect the price now.

HCLTECH.watch: A close at or above 1,437.78 (+1R) moves the stop to cost; Infosys results 23 Oct and Cognizant 29 Oct set the sector tone; stop 1,225.82.

GROWW.summary: No company filing or news since the 16 Oct transcript. GROWW fell about 3.8% to 190.52, closing near the day's low, as capital-market and small/mid-cap stocks were sold (BSE Ltd -2.6%, Smallcap index -2.5%). It is now 0.9% above the 188.75 stop (1% under the 190.66 result-day low): this is market and sector pressure, not new company information, but it puts the trade at risk.

points.text: Close 190.52 vs entry 200.80 (-0.85R); the close was in the bottom 18% of the day's range; stop 188.75.
BSE Ltd was among the day's top NSE losers (-2.63%), a sign of selling across capital-market stocks.
Last company filing is the 16 Oct call transcript; nothing filed since.

GROWW.watch: A close below 188.75 is the exit; a close back above 200.80 repairs the setup.

SEJALLTD.summary: No new filing or company news since the 19 Oct presentation and call recording, and the call kept FY27 guidance. The stock fell to 839.30 in a broad small-cap sell-off and closed just 0.15% above the 838.03 stop (1% under the 846.50 result-day low), near the day's low. The fundamentals have not changed, but the starter is one weak tick from its exit.

points.text: Close 839.30 vs entry 879.95 (-0.97R); stop 838.03; close in the bottom 19% of the day's range on lighter volume (0.7x average).
Nifty Smallcap 100 -2.5% to a four-month low today; about 254 NSE stocks hit lower circuits.
FY27 guidance kept on the call: revenue growth 25-40%, EBITDA margin about 18%.

SEJALLTD.watch: A close below 838.03 exits the starter; do not add unless it closes back above 879.95.
